Statement from Secretary of State Marco Rubio – The White House Briefings & Statements Statement from Secretary of State Marco Rubio The White House June 12, 2025 “Tonight, Israel took unilateral action against Iran. We are not involved in strikes against Iran and our top priority is protecting American forces in the region. Israel advised us that they believe this action was necessary for its self-defense. President Trump and the Administration have taken all necessary steps to protect our forces and remain in close contact with our regional partners. Let me be clear: Iran should not target U.S. interests or personnel.” Related WHAT THEY ARE SAYING: President Trump’s Display of Peace Through Strength Releases June 22, 2025 Peace Through Strength: President Trump Launches Operation Epic Fury to Crush Iranian Regime, End Nuclear Threat Releases March 1, 2026 Text of a Letter from the President to the Speaker of the House of Representatives and the President Pro Tempore of the Senate Briefings & Statements April 22, 2025 President Trump Delivers Powerful Primetime Address on Operation Epic Fury Releases April 1, 2026 SUNDAY SHOWS: President Trump’s Pursuit of Peace Through Strength in Iran Releases June 22, 2025 Notifications
